title: Akshaj's ore recipe's
description: this datapack gives u new recipe's for making ores from their products.
body:
Akshaj's Ore Recipes
Ever wished you could craft ores instead of spending hours mining for them? This datapack makes that possible by adding custom crafting recipes for various ores in Minecraft.
With Akshaj's Ore Recipes, you can craft ore blocks directly using balanced and survival-friendly recipes. It's a great addition for players who want more flexibility in resource gathering while keeping the gameplay fun and rewarding.

Features:

1.Adds custom crafting recipes for multiple overworld ore blocks


2.Survival-friendly and easy to use


3.Works seamlessly in vanilla Minecraft — no mods required


4.Perfect for survival, skyblock, and custom challenge worlds


5.Works for server and client side


Current Ores Included:


•Coal Ore


•Copper Ore


•Iron Ore


•Gold Ore


•Redstone Ore


•Lapis Lazuli Ore


•Diamond Ore


•Emerald Ore


Coming Soon
🔥 Nether Ore Update!
Future updates will add crafting recipes for Nether ores, including:


•Nether Gold Ore


•Nether Quartz Ore


•And potentially more Nether-related resources


Installation


Download the datapack.


Place it in your world's datapacks folder.


Run /reload or restart your world.


Start crafting ores right away!


Bring a whole new level of convenience and creativity to your Minecraft world with Akshaj's Ore Recipes. Happy crafting!
